body.purpose: Default everywhere: list items, drawer labels, dialogs, menu captions.

title.purpose: Panel headings like the Histórico header (Quasar text-subtitle1).

key-label.purpose: Calculator key labels and stack values — the loudest text; uppercased by the button component.

caption.purpose: History expression lines and the secondary row of drawer links.

motion.name: hover-transition
motion.purpose: Quasar generic hover/press transition on all buttons and interactive surfaces.

motion.name: field-transition
motion.purpose: Outlined field label float and border-color shifts in the drawer selects.

motion.name: page-fade
motion.purpose: Router-view enter/leave (animate.css fadeIn / fadeOut, the only enabled animations).

motion.name: tooltip-delay
motion.purpose: Every key tooltip delay, with a [0, 10] offset.

breakpoints.name: history-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the 220px history rail detaches and moves under the keypad at full width (max 400px, 300px tall).

components.name: Calculator Key
components.description: The primary pill key: transparent outline, uppercase label, 4-per-row grid cell.
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; min-height: 2.572em; padding: 4px 16px; background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 28px; font: 500 1.25rem/1.715 Roboto, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.5,1); } .ds-key:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-key:active { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,.2); }

components.name: Stack Display Row
components.description: Signature component: the read-only, copy-on-click stack line with a depth icon left and value right.
components.css: .ds-stack-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 2.572em; padding: 4px 16px; background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 28px; font: 500 1.25rem/1.715 Roboto, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.5,1); } .ds-stack-row:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-stack-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stack-row__icon { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 1.715em; height: 1.715em; } .ds-stack-row__value { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Header Icon Button
components.description: Flat round icon button in the transparent header; color flips with the text theme.
components.html: <button class="ds-header-icon" aria-label="Menu"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18v2H3V6zm0 5h18v2H3v-2zm0 5h18v2H3v-2z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-header-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px; background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.5,1); } .ds-header-icon:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-header-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: History List Item
components.description: Two-line result row: caption expression over body-weight result, hairline separator, click to copy.
components.css: .ds-history-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 48px; justify-content: center; color: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(128,128,128,.35); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.5,1); } .ds-history-item:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-history-item__expr { font: 400 .75rem/1.375rem Roboto, sans-serif; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-history-item__result { font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Gradient Swatch Button
components.description: Gradients-page chip: full-bleed gradient fill whose label color is computed from the first stop's luminance.
components.css: .ds-swatch { min-width: 100px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #13505b, #0c7489, #119da4); color: #fff; font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Roboto, sans-serif; text-transform: none; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.5,1); } .ds-swatch:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-swatch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Select
components.description: Drawer settings field: transparent outlined control with floating label (Cor do Texto, Gradiente).
components.css: .ds-select { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.62); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .36s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-select:hover, .ds-select:focus-within { border-color: #fff; } .ds-select__label { position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 8px; padding: 0 4px; background: transparent; font: 400 .75rem/1.375rem Roboto, sans-serif; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); } .ds-select__value { font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Roboto, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
This is a measuring tool, not a showpiece. The calculator states its whole working state — a four-line visible stack — as large, plainly-labelled keys, and asks nothing else of the user. Every default favors legibility over polish: flat surfaces, one border weight, one type family, a single 400px column centered on the page. The personality arrives through a deliberate wink rather than through chrome: the entire canvas is a customizable gradient (the "estilo R$1,99" self-awareness of the README made visual), an avatar in the header opens an auto-closing "Desenvolvido por" dialog, and the palette is a teal family that reads as instrument-panel rather than brand-campaign.

Density is high and rhythm is mechanical: four keys per row, identical 8px gutters, no decorative spacing. The system is theme-aware — dark by default, with a user-facing "Cor do Texto" toggle — and the gradient background is the one surface that changes character, so foreground elements stay strictly neutral outline shapes that work over any color world the user picks. Confirmed anti-reference: corporate SaaS chrome (cards, elevated panels, gradient buttons) and skeuomorphic calculator textures (bevels, LCD panels, plastic keys).
keyCharacteristics: Flat outline vocabulary: transparent fills, 1px `currentColor` borders, no shadows anywhere
Fully-rounded pill keys (28px radius) in a strict 4-column grid
A single centered 400px instrument column with an optional 220px history rail
Teal brand family (Petrol Teal / Bright Lagoon / Shadowed Pine) as the default gradient world
Roboto throughout; uppercase, medium-weight key labels
The gradient canvas is user-owned — foreground UI must stay legible over any of it

rules.name: The Gradient-Owner Rule
rules.body: The background is the user's, not the system's. Foreground elements never borrow gradient colors for fills or text; they stay neutral outlines so they remain legible over any swatch.

rules.name: The One-World Rule
rules.body: Only one gradient is active at a time, and the default teal family is the reference world. New surfaces are designed against the default gradient first.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Roboto only. Introducing a second family — especially a mono "calculator font" — is off-brand for the honest instrument.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow` is ever added to a resting element. If something needs to feel above the canvas, it gets a border or the scrim, never a shadow.

dos: **Do** keep every resting surface flat and outlined: transparent fill + 1px `currentColor` border (pill radius 28px for labelled controls).
**Do** design against the default teal gradient first — the foreground must stay legible over Shadowed Pine → Deep Petrol Teal → Bright Lagoon and over any user swatch.
**Do** keep the instrument column at 400px max with 8px gutters and the 4-column key grid; the 719px breakpoint is where the history rail moves below the keypad.
**Do** keep text theme binary (white on dark, black on light) and let Quasar's caption grey be the only secondary tone.
**Do** put a 1000ms tooltip and an `aria-label` on every icon-only control, matching the incumbent coverage.
donts: **Don't** add box-shadows, elevation cards, or beveled/skeuomorphic key treatments — the system is flat by decree.
**Don't** add a second typeface or a "calculator-style" mono/display font.
**Don't** fill foreground elements with gradient colors or brand teal; teal lives in the canvas, outlines live in the UI.
**Don't** invent radii beyond the set — 28px pills, 50% rounds, 4px fields — or spacing steps outside 4px / 8px / 16px.
**Don't** spread the manifest's legacy navy (`#1a2a6c`) into UI elements — it is packaging metadata, not part of the palette.
